raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "speak with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the doctor from the hospital in Bocsa"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "yesterday"

@s2 stated
  relation "be about"
  role subject "the conversation"
  role object "the user's brother"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "visit"
    role subject "the user"
    role destination "the user's brother"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
